WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b), q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(falling) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) fall3 FROM q) SELECT store_id,month_key,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(net-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) mom_pct,ROUND(100.0*(net-prior_year)/NULLIF(prior_year,0),2) yoy_pct,CASE WHEN fall3=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END three_declines FROM z WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY store_id,month_key

WITH a AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_cents) net, SUM(cost_cents) cost, SUM(refund_cents) refund
  FROM v_sales_lines
  WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY store_id
), b AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets
  WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-10' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id
), p AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, COALESCE(a.net,0) net, COALESCE(a.cost,0) cost,
    COALESCE(a.refund,0) refund, b.target,
    100.0*(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(a.net,0) margin,
    100.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.target,0) attainment,
    100.0*a.refund/NULLIF(a.net+a.refund,0) refund_rate
  FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT 100.0*SUM(net-cost)/NULLIF(SUM(net),0) margin,
    100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN net ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN target ELSE 0 END),0) attainment,
    100.0*SUM(refund)/NULLIF(SUM(net+refund),0) refund_rate FROM p
), z AS (
  SELECT p.*,
    CASE WHEN p.margin<benchmark.margin-1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    +CASE WHEN p.attainment<benchmark.attainment*.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    +CASE WHEN p.refund_rate>benchmark.refund_rate*1.25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END flags,
    RANK() OVER(ORDER BY net DESC) sales_rank FROM p CROSS JOIN benchmark
)

  ROUND(attainment,2) achievement_pct, ROUND(refund_rate,2) refund_pct, flags, sales_rank

WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-10-03' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold_units,i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents stock_value_cents,ROUND(90.0*i.quantity/NULLIF(s.sold,0),2) cover_days FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.active=1 AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents>500000 AND COALESCE(s.sold,0)<20 ORDER BY stock_value_cents DESC,i.warehouse_id,i.product_id

WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), l AS (SELECT p.warehouse_id,i.product_id,SUM((b.day_index-a.day_index)*(g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected))*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected),0) lead_days FROM goods_receipts g JOIN purchase_order_items i ON i.po_item_id=g.po_item_id JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN calendar_days a ON a.day=p.order_date JOIN calendar_days b ON b.day=g.receipt_date WHERE g.receipt_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.warehouse_id,i.product_id), z AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold,COALESCE(l.lead_days,14) lead_days FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN l ON l.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND l.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND p.active=1) SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,quantity,sold,ROUND(lead_days,2) lead_days,ROUND(sold*lead_days/30.0-quantity,2) expected_shortage FROM z WHERE sold*lead_days/30.0>quantity ORDER BY expected_shortage DESC,warehouse_id,product_id

WITH a AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,'2023-01-01' d,0 seq,quantity q FROM inventory_opening WHERE quantity>0 UNION ALL SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,movement_date,movement_id,quantity_delta FROM stock_movements WHERE quantity_delta>0 AND movement_date<='2025-12-31'), b AS (SELECT *,SUM(q) OVER(PARTITION BY warehouse_id,product_id ORDER BY d,seq ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) cum FROM a), s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE quantity_delta<0 AND movement_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), z AS (SELECT b.*,CASE WHEN b.cum<=COALESCE(s.sold,0) THEN 0 WHEN b.cum-b.q>=COALESCE(s.sold,0) THEN b.q ELSE b.cum-COALESCE(s.sold,0) END remain FROM b LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=b.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=b.product_id), g AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(CASE WHEN d<='2025-07-04' THEN remain ELSE 0 END) aged,SUM(remain) total FROM z GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT g.warehouse_id,g.product_id,g.aged aged_units,g.aged*i.unit_cost_cents aged_value_cents,ROUND(100.0*g.aged/NULLIF(g.total,0),2) aged_pct FROM g JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.warehouse_id=g.warehouse_id AND i.product_id=g.product_id AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' WHERE g.aged>0 ORDER BY aged_value_cents DESC,g.warehouse_id,g.product_id

WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND (order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a) SELECT b.customer_id,1095-d.day_index recency_days,freq,money net_cents,r_score,f_score,m_score,CASE WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score>=13 THEN 'high_value' WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score<=6 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'regular' END segment FROM b JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=b.last_day ORDER BY b.customer_id

WITH s AS (SELECT source_id,COUNT(*) sessions FROM customer_sessions WHERE (session_date>='2025-01-01' AND session_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY source_id), o AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online'), a AS (SELECT t.source_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.session_id) converted,SUM(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) new_customers,SUM(net_cents) net FROM o JOIN customer_sessions t ON t.session_id=o.session_id WHERE (t.session_date>='2025-01-01' AND t.session_date<='2025-12-31') AND (o.order_date>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY t.source_id), p AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE (month_key>='2025-01' AND month_key<='2025-12') GROUP BY source_id) SELECT t.source_id,COALESCE(s.sessions,0) sessions,COALESCE(a.converted,0) converted,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(a.converted,0)/NULLIF(s.sessions,0),2) conversion_pct,COALESCE(a.new_customers,0) new_customers,p.spend spend_cents,ROUND(1.0*p.spend/NULLIF(a.new_customers,0),2) cac_cents,ROUND(1.0*a.net/NULLIF(p.spend,0),4) roas FROM traffic_sources t LEFT JOIN s ON s.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN a ON a.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN p ON p.source_id=t.source_id ORDER BY t.source_id

WITH b AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,account_id), a AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY department_id,account_id) SELECT b.department_id,b.account_id,b.budget budget_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0) actual_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget variance_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget)/NULLIF(b.budget,0),2) variance_pct,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.actual,0)>b.budget*1.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END over_budget FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.department_id=b.department_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id ORDER BY b.department_id,b.account_id

WITH a AS (
  SELECT 0 unreferenced, reference_no ref, SUM(expense_cents) ledger
  FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no
), b AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unreferenced,
    COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR)) ref, SUM(-amount_cents) bank
  FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR))
), k AS (
  SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM a UNION SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM b
)
SELECT CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN CONCAT('BANK-',k.ref) ELSE k.ref END ref,
  a.ledger ledger_cents,b.bank bank_cents,COALESCE(b.bank,0)-COALESCE(a.ledger,0) difference_cents,
  CASE WHEN a.ref IS NULL THEN 'bank_only' WHEN b.ref IS NULL THEN 'ledger_only' ELSE 'difference' END issue,
  CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN 'unreferenced_bank' ELSE 'reference' END reference_kind
FROM k LEFT JOIN a ON a.ref=k.ref AND a.unreferenced=k.unreferenced
LEFT JOIN b ON b.ref=k.ref AND b.unreferenced=k.unreferenced
WHERE a.ref IS NULL OR b.ref IS NULL OR a.ledger<>b.bank ORDER BY ref,reference_kind

WITH f AS (
  SELECT x.supplier_invoice_id,SUM(x.quantity_billed*x.unit_price_cents) face,
    SUM(x.quantity_billed*p.unit_price_cents) expected
  FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN purchase_order_items p ON p.po_item_id=x.po_item_id
  GROUP BY x.supplier_invoice_id
), a AS (
  SELECT v.*,f.face,f.expected,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id,invoice_no) copies,
    AVG(f.face) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id) avg_bill
  FROM v_invoice_balance v JOIN f ON f.supplier_invoice_id=v.supplier_invoice_id
), z AS (
  SELECT a.*,CASE WHEN copies>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END duplicate_flag,
    CASE WHEN face>2*avg_bill THEN 1 ELSE 0 END large_flag,
    CASE WHEN balance_cents<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END overpay_flag,
    CASE WHEN ABS(face-expected)>100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END mismatch_flag FROM a
)
SELECT supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,billed_cents,duplicate_flag,large_flag,overpay_flag,mismatch_flag,
  duplicate_flag+large_flag+overpay_flag+mismatch_flag flags FROM z
WHERE duplicate_flag+large_flag+overpay_flag+mismatch_flag>0 ORDER BY flags DESC,supplier_invoice_id

WITH m AS (SELECT month_key,MIN(day) first_day,MAX(day) last_day,MIN(day_index) first_idx FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2024-11' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key), a AS (SELECT d.department_id,m.month_key,SUM(CASE WHEN h.start_date< m.first_day AND (h.end_date IS NULL OR h.end_date>=m.first_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) opening,SUM(CASE WHEN h.start_date<=m.last_day AND (h.end_date IS NULL OR h.end_date>m.last_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) closing,SUM(CASE WHEN e.termination_date BETWEEN m.first_day AND m.last_day AND h.end_date=e.termination_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) exits FROM departments d CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN employment_history h ON h.department_id=d.department_id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id=h.employee_id GROUP BY d.department_id,m.month_key), b AS (SELECT *, (opening+closing)/2.0 avg_h FROM a), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(exits) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) e3,SUM(avg_h) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) h3,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) n3 FROM b) SELECT department_id,month_key,opening,closing,exits,ROUND(100.0*exits/NULLIF(avg_h,0),2) exit_pct,CASE WHEN n3=3 THEN ROUND(100.0*e3/NULLIF(h3,0),2) ELSE NULL END rolling_pct FROM z WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY department_id,month_key

WITH a AS (SELECT e.employee_id,h.department_id,e.hire_date,e.termination_date,d.day_index hire_idx,t.day_index term_idx,CONCAT(SUBSTR(e.hire_date,1,4),'-Q',CASE WHEN SUBSTR(e.hire_date,6,2)<='03' THEN '1' WHEN SUBSTR(e.hire_date,6,2)<='06' THEN '2' WHEN SUBSTR(e.hire_date,6,2)<='09' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END) cohort FROM employees e JOIN employment_history h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id AND h.start_date=e.hire_date JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=e.hire_date LEFT JOIN calendar_days t ON t.day=e.termination_date), b AS (SELECT department_id,cohort,SUM(CASE WHEN hire_idx+90<=1095 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n90,SUM(CASE WHEN hire_idx+90<=1095 AND (term_idx IS NULL OR term_idx>hire_idx+90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r90,SUM(CASE WHEN hire_idx+180<=1095 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n180,SUM(CASE WHEN hire_idx+180<=1095 AND (term_idx IS NULL OR term_idx>hire_idx+180) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r180 FROM a GROUP BY department_id,cohort) SELECT department_id,cohort,n90,ROUND(100.0*r90/NULLIF(n90,0),2) retention90_pct,n180,ROUND(100.0*r180/NULLIF(n180,0),2) retention180_pct FROM b ORDER BY department_id,cohort

WITH a AS (SELECT e.employee_id,h.department_id,e.hire_date,e.termination_date,d.day_index hire_idx,t.day_index term_idx,CONCAT(SUBSTR(e.hire_date,1,4),'-Q',CASE WHEN SUBSTR(e.hire_date,6,2)<='03' THEN '1' WHEN SUBSTR(e.hire_date,6,2)<='06' THEN '2' WHEN SUBSTR(e.hire_date,6,2)<='09' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END) cohort FROM employees e JOIN employment_history h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id AND h.start_date=e.hire_date JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=e.hire_date LEFT JOIN calendar_days t ON t.day=e.termination_date), b AS (SELECT department_id,cohort,COUNT(CASE WHEN hire_idx+90<=1095 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) n90,COUNT(CASE WHEN hire_idx+90<=1095 AND (term_idx IS NULL OR term_idx>hire_idx+90) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) r90,COUNT(CASE WHEN hire_idx+180<=1095 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) n180,COUNT(CASE WHEN hire_idx+180<=1095 AND (term_idx IS NULL OR term_idx>hire_idx+180) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) r180 FROM a GROUP BY department_id,cohort) SELECT department_id,cohort,n90,ROUND(100.0*r90/NULLIF(n90,0),2) retention90_pct,n180,ROUND(100.0*r180/NULLIF(n180,0),2) retention180_pct FROM b ORDER BY department_id,cohort

WITH a AS (SELECT i.po_item_id,p.supplier_id,i.product_id,p.order_date,i.unit_price_cents,c.unit_price_cents contract_cents,LAG(i.unit_price_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY p.supplier_id,i.product_id ORDER BY p.order_date,i.po_item_id) previous_cents FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE p.status<>'cancelled') SELECT po_item_id,supplier_id,product_id,unit_price_cents,contract_cents,unit_price_cents-contract_cents contract_variance_cents,previous_cents,ROUND(100.0*(unit_price_cents-previous_cents)/NULLIF(previous_cents,0),2) change_pct FROM a WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY po_item_id

WITH a AS (SELECT i.po_item_id,p.supplier_id,i.product_id,p.order_date,i.unit_price_cents,c.unit_price_cents contract_cents,LAG(i.unit_price_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY p.supplier_id,i.product_id ORDER BY p.order_date,i.po_item_id) previous_cents FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE p.status<>'cancelled') SELECT po_item_id,supplier_id,product_id,unit_price_cents,contract_cents,unit_price_cents-contract_cents contract_variance_cents,previous_cents,ROUND(100.0*(unit_price_cents-previous_cents)/NULLIF(previous_cents,0),2) change_pct FROM a WHERE (order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<='2025-12-31') ORDER BY po_item_id

SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) due_lines,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) ontime_pct,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN accepted>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) complete_pct,ROUND(100.0*SUM(accepted)/NULLIF(SUM(received),0),2) quality_pct FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY supplier_id

SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) due_lines,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) ontime_pct,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN accepted>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) complete_pct,ROUND(100.0*SUM(accepted)/NULLIF(SUM(received),0),2) quality_pct FROM v_po_lines WHERE (promised_date>='2025-01-01' AND promised_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY supplier_id

WITH billed AS (
  SELECT x.po_item_id,SUM(x.quantity_billed) billed,SUM(x.quantity_billed*x.unit_price_cents) billed_cents
  FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN supplier_invoices f ON f.supplier_invoice_id=x.supplier_invoice_id
  WHERE f.invoice_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY x.po_item_id
), checked AS (
  SELECT v.po_item_id,v.po_id,v.supplier_id,v.product_id,v.quantity_ordered,v.accepted,
    COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed,COALESCE(b.billed_cents,0) billed_cents,v.accepted*v.unit_price_cents expected_cents
  FROM v_po_lines v LEFT JOIN billed b ON b.po_item_id=v.po_item_id
  WHERE v.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT po_item_id,po_id,supplier_id,product_id,quantity_ordered,accepted,billed,billed_cents,expected_cents,
  billed_cents-expected_cents variance_cents FROM checked
WHERE quantity_ordered<>accepted OR accepted<>billed OR billed_cents<>expected_cents ORDER BY po_item_id

WITH billed AS (
  SELECT x.po_item_id,SUM(x.quantity_billed) billed,SUM(x.quantity_billed*x.unit_price_cents) billed_cents
  FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN supplier_invoices f ON f.supplier_invoice_id=x.supplier_invoice_id
  WHERE f.invoice_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY x.po_item_id
), checked AS (
  SELECT v.po_item_id,v.po_id,v.supplier_id,v.product_id,v.quantity_ordered,v.accepted,
    COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed,COALESCE(b.billed_cents,0) billed_cents,v.accepted*v.unit_price_cents expected_cents
  FROM v_po_lines v LEFT JOIN billed b ON b.po_item_id=v.po_item_id
  WHERE (v.order_date>='2025-01-01' AND v.order_date<='2025-12-31')
)
SELECT po_item_id,po_id,supplier_id,product_id,quantity_ordered,accepted,billed,billed_cents,expected_cents,
  billed_cents-expected_cents variance_cents FROM checked
WHERE quantity_ordered<>accepted OR accepted<>billed OR billed_cents<>expected_cents ORDER BY po_item_id

WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents)*1.0/SUM(quantity_ordered) avg_price FROM v_po_lines WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id,supplier_id), b AS (SELECT *,MIN(avg_price) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id) low,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id) n FROM a) SELECT product_id,supplier_id,ROUND(avg_price*100,0)/100.0 weighted_price_cents,ROUND(low*100,0)/100.0 low_price_cents,ROUND(100.0*(avg_price-low)/NULLIF(low,0),2) premium_pct FROM b WHERE n>=2 ORDER BY product_id,premium_pct,supplier_id

WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents)*1.0/SUM(quantity_ordered) avg_price FROM v_po_lines WHERE (order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY product_id,supplier_id), b AS (SELECT *,MIN(avg_price) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id) low,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id) n FROM a) SELECT product_id,supplier_id,ROUND(avg_price*100,0)/100.0 weighted_price_cents,ROUND(low*100,0)/100.0 low_price_cents,ROUND(100.0*(avg_price-low)/NULLIF(low,0),2) premium_pct FROM b WHERE n>=2 ORDER BY product_id,premium_pct,supplier_id

WITH a AS (SELECT v.supplier_id,COUNT(*) n,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.on_time>=v.quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) ot,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.accepted>=v.quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) fill,100.0*SUM(accepted)/NULLIF(SUM(received),0) quality,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.unit_price_cents<=c.unit_price_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) price_ok FROM v_po_lines v JOIN purchase_order_items i ON i.po_item_id=v.po_item_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE v.promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY v.supplier_id) SELECT supplier_id,n due_lines,ROUND(ot,2) ontime_pct,ROUND(fill,2) complete_pct,ROUND(quality,2) quality_pct,ROUND(price_ok,2) contract_pct,ROUND(.4*ot+.25*fill+.2*quality+.15*price_ok,2) score FROM a WHERE n>=10 ORDER BY score DESC,supplier_id

WITH a AS (SELECT v.supplier_id,COUNT(*) n,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.on_time>=v.quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) ot,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.accepted>=v.quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) fill,100.0*SUM(accepted)/NULLIF(SUM(received),0) quality,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.unit_price_cents<=c.unit_price_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) price_ok FROM v_po_lines v JOIN purchase_order_items i ON i.po_item_id=v.po_item_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE (v.promised_date>='2025-01-01' AND v.promised_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY v.supplier_id) SELECT supplier_id,n due_lines,ROUND(ot,2) ontime_pct,ROUND(fill,2) complete_pct,ROUND(quality,2) quality_pct,ROUND(price_ok,2) contract_pct,ROUND(.4*ot+.25*fill+.2*quality+.15*price_ok,2) score FROM a WHERE n>=10 ORDER BY score DESC,supplier_id

WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), a AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents value_cents,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND p.active=1) SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,quantity,sold,value_cents,CASE WHEN sold>=30 AND quantity<sold*.5 THEN 'fast_shortage' ELSE 'slow_excess' END issue FROM a WHERE (sold>=30 AND quantity<sold*.5) OR (sold<=3 AND value_cents>=300000) ORDER BY issue,value_cents DESC,warehouse_id,product_id

WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND (movement_date>='2025-12-02' AND movement_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), a AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents value_cents,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND p.active=1) SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,quantity,sold,value_cents,CASE WHEN sold>=30 AND quantity<sold*.5 THEN 'fast_shortage' ELSE 'slow_excess' END issue FROM a WHERE (sold>=30 AND quantity<sold*.5) OR (sold<=3 AND value_cents>=300000) ORDER BY issue,value_cents DESC,warehouse_id,product_id

WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_cents) stock FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date='2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), z AS (SELECT p.product_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net,COALESCE(b.stock,0) stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN a ON a.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.product_id=p.product_id), q AS (SELECT *,100.0*net/NULLIF(SUM(net) OVER(),0) sales_share,100.0*stock/NULLIF(SUM(stock) OVER(),0) stock_share FROM z) SELECT product_id,net net_cents,stock stock_cents,ROUND(sales_share,4) sales_pct,ROUND(stock_share,4) stock_pct,ROUND(stock_share-sales_share,4) gap_points FROM q ORDER BY gap_points DESC,product_id

WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE (order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_cents) stock FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date='2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), z AS (SELECT p.product_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net,COALESCE(b.stock,0) stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN a ON a.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.product_id=p.product_id), q AS (SELECT *,100.0*net/NULLIF(SUM(net) OVER(),0) sales_share,100.0*stock/NULLIF(SUM(stock) OVER(),0) stock_share FROM z) SELECT product_id,net net_cents,stock stock_cents,ROUND(sales_share,4) sales_pct,ROUND(stock_share,4) stock_pct,ROUND(stock_share-sales_share,4) gap_points FROM q ORDER BY gap_points DESC,product_id

WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), a AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND p.active=1), b AS (SELECT *,quantity-2*sold surplus,sold-quantity shortage FROM a) SELECT x.product_id,x.warehouse_id from_warehouse,y.warehouse_id to_warehouse,CASE WHEN x.surplus<y.shortage THEN x.surplus ELSE y.shortage END proposed_units FROM b x JOIN b y ON y.product_id=x.product_id AND y.warehouse_id<>x.warehouse_id WHERE x.surplus>=10 AND y.shortage>0 ORDER BY x.product_id,x.warehouse_id,y.warehouse_id

WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND (movement_date>='2025-12-02' AND movement_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), a AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND p.active=1), b AS (SELECT *,quantity-2*sold surplus,sold-quantity shortage FROM a) SELECT x.product_id,x.warehouse_id from_warehouse,y.warehouse_id to_warehouse,CASE WHEN x.surplus<y.shortage THEN x.surplus ELSE y.shortage END proposed_units FROM b x JOIN b y ON y.product_id=x.product_id AND y.warehouse_id<>x.warehouse_id WHERE x.surplus>=10 AND y.shortage>0 ORDER BY x.product_id,x.warehouse_id,y.warehouse_id

WITH a AS (SELECT p.category_id,SUM(s.net_cents-s.cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines s JOIN products p ON p.product_id=s.product_id WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.category_id), b AS (SELECT p.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM products p CROSS JOIN warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY p.category_id) SELECT c.category_id,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,b.avg_stock avg_stock_cents,ROUND(COALESCE(a.gross,0)/NULLIF(b.avg_stock,0),4) gmroi FROM categories c LEFT JOIN a ON a.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.category_id=c.category_id ORDER BY gmroi DESC,c.category_id

WITH a AS (SELECT p.category_id,SUM(s.net_cents-s.cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines s JOIN products p ON p.product_id=s.product_id WHERE (s.order_date>='2025-01-01' AND s.order_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY p.category_id), b AS (SELECT p.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM products p CROSS JOIN warehouses w LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY p.category_id) SELECT c.category_id,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,b.avg_stock avg_stock_cents,ROUND(COALESCE(a.gross,0)/NULLIF(b.avg_stock,0),4) gmroi FROM categories c LEFT JOIN a ON a.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.category_id=c.category_id ORDER BY gmroi DESC,c.category_id

WITH p AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(quantity_ordered-accepted) overdue FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date<='2025-12-31' AND accepted<quantity_ordered GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,s.sold demand,p.overdue overdue_units,s.sold-i.quantity shortage FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN p ON p.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND p.product_id=i.product_id JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity<s.sold ORDER BY shortage DESC,i.warehouse_id,i.product_id

WITH p AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(quantity_ordered-accepted) overdue FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date<='2025-12-31' AND accepted<quantity_ordered GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND (movement_date>='2025-12-02' AND movement_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,s.sold demand,p.overdue overdue_units,s.sold-i.quantity shortage FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN p ON p.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND p.product_id=i.product_id JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity<s.sold ORDER BY shortage DESC,i.warehouse_id,i.product_id

WITH a AS (SELECT receipt_id,SUM(quantity_delta) qty FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='receipt' GROUP BY receipt_id) SELECT g.receipt_id,g.po_item_id,g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected expected_units,COALESCE(a.qty,0) posted_units,COALESCE(a.qty,0)-(g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected) difference FROM goods_receipts g LEFT JOIN a ON a.receipt_id=g.receipt_id WHERE COALESCE(a.qty,0)<>g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected ORDER BY g.receipt_id

WITH a AS (SELECT receipt_id,SUM(quantity_delta) qty FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='receipt' GROUP BY receipt_id) SELECT g.receipt_id,g.po_item_id,g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected expected_units,IFNULL(a.qty,0) posted_units,IFNULL(a.qty,0)-(g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected) difference FROM goods_receipts g LEFT JOIN a ON a.receipt_id=g.receipt_id WHERE IFNULL(a.qty,0)<>g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected ORDER BY g.receipt_id

WITH a AS (
  SELECT supplier_id,warehouse_id,product_id,SUM((quantity_ordered-accepted)*unit_price_cents) overdue_value
  FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND quantity_ordered>accepted
  GROUP BY supplier_id,warehouse_id,product_id
)
SELECT a.supplier_id,COUNT(*) affected_pairs,SUM(a.overdue_value) overdue_cents,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents) ELSE NULL END exposed_stock_cents
FROM a LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.warehouse_id=a.warehouse_id AND i.product_id=a.product_id
  AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31'
GROUP BY a.supplier_id ORDER BY overdue_cents DESC,a.supplier_id

WITH a AS (
  SELECT supplier_id,warehouse_id,product_id,SUM((quantity_ordered-accepted)*unit_price_cents) overdue_value
  FROM v_po_lines WHERE (promised_date>='2025-01-01' AND promised_date<='2025-12-31') AND quantity_ordered>accepted
  GROUP BY supplier_id,warehouse_id,product_id
)
SELECT a.supplier_id,COUNT(*) affected_pairs,SUM(a.overdue_value) overdue_cents,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents) ELSE NULL END exposed_stock_cents
FROM a LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.warehouse_id=a.warehouse_id AND i.product_id=a.product_id
  AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31'
GROUP BY a.supplier_id ORDER BY overdue_cents DESC,a.supplier_id

WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.cost,0) cost_cents,COALESCE(b.expense,0) expense_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0)-COALESCE(b.expense,0) contribution_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0)-COALESCE(b.expense,0))/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) contribution_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC,s.store_id

WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND (order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE (entry_date>='2025-01-01' AND entry_date<='2025-12-31') AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.cost,0) cost_cents,COALESCE(b.expense,0) expense_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0)-COALESCE(b.expense,0) contribution_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0)-COALESCE(b.expense,0))/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) contribution_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC,s.store_id

WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0) cash_net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)-o.net_cents difference_cents FROM v_order_net o LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)<>o.net_cents ORDER BY o.order_id

WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0) cash_net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)-o.net_cents difference_cents FROM v_order_net o LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.order_id=o.order_id WHERE (o.order_date>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_date<='2025-12-31') AND COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)<>o.net_cents ORDER BY o.order_id

WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2024-11' AND '2025-12'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2024-11-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7) m,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2024-11-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7)), z AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net,COALESCE(b.expense,0) expense FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id AND b.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) n3,SUM(expense) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) e3,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) k FROM z) SELECT store_id,month_key,net net_cents,expense expense_cents,ROUND(100.0*expense/NULLIF(net,0),2) expense_pct,CASE WHEN k=3 THEN ROUND(100.0*e3/NULLIF(n3,0),2) ELSE NULL END rolling_pct FROM p WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY store_id,month_key

WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE (month_key>='2024-11' AND month_key<='2025-12')), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND (order_date>='2024-11-01' AND order_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7) m,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE (entry_date>='2024-11-01' AND entry_date<='2025-12-31') AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7)), z AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net,COALESCE(b.expense,0) expense FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id AND b.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) n3,SUM(expense) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) e3,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) k FROM z) SELECT store_id,month_key,net net_cents,expense expense_cents,ROUND(100.0*expense/NULLIF(net,0),2) expense_pct,CASE WHEN k=3 THEN ROUND(100.0*e3/NULLIF(n3,0),2) ELSE NULL END rolling_pct FROM p WHERE (month_key>='2025-01' AND month_key<='2025-12') ORDER BY store_id,month_key

WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT s.supplier_id,COALESCE(a.ordered,0) ordered_cents,COALESCE(a.received,0) received_cents,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed_cents,COALESCE(b.paid,0) paid_cents,COALESCE(b.balance,0) balance_cents FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id ORDER BY balance_cents DESC,s.supplier_id

WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT s.supplier_id,IFNULL(a.ordered,0) ordered_cents,IFNULL(a.received,0) received_cents,IFNULL(b.billed,0) billed_cents,IFNULL(b.paid,0) paid_cents,IFNULL(b.balance,0) balance_cents FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id ORDER BY balance_cents DESC,s.supplier_id

WITH receipts AS (
  SELECT po_item_id,SUM(quantity_received-quantity_rejected) accepted
  FROM goods_receipts WHERE receipt_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY po_item_id
), lines AS (
  SELECT x.*,p.unit_price_cents po_price,COALESCE(r.accepted,0) accepted,
    COALESCE(SUM(x.quantity_billed) OVER(PARTITION BY x.po_item_id
      ORDER BY f.invoice_date,f.supplier_invoice_id,x.supplier_invoice_item_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) prior_billed
  FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN supplier_invoices f ON f.supplier_invoice_id=x.supplier_invoice_id
  JOIN purchase_order_items p ON p.po_item_id=x.po_item_id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.po_item_id=x.po_item_id
  WHERE f.invoice_date<='2025-12-31'
), allocated AS (
  SELECT supplier_invoice_id,SUM(CASE WHEN accepted<=prior_billed THEN 0
    WHEN accepted-prior_billed>=quantity_billed THEN quantity_billed
    ELSE accepted-prior_billed END*po_price) received FROM lines GROUP BY supplier_invoice_id
)
SELECT b.supplier_invoice_id,b.po_id,b.billed_cents,b.paid_cents,a.received received_cents,
  b.billed_cents-a.received bill_difference_cents,b.paid_cents-a.received paid_difference_cents
FROM v_invoice_balance b JOIN allocated a ON a.supplier_invoice_id=b.supplier_invoice_id
WHERE b.paid_cents>0 AND ABS(b.billed_cents-a.received)>100
ORDER BY ABS(b.billed_cents-a.received) DESC,b.supplier_invoice_id

WITH receipts AS (
  SELECT po_item_id,SUM(quantity_received-quantity_rejected) accepted
  FROM goods_receipts WHERE receipt_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY po_item_id
), lines AS (
  SELECT x.*,p.unit_price_cents po_price,IFNULL(r.accepted,0) accepted,
    IFNULL(SUM(x.quantity_billed) OVER(PARTITION BY x.po_item_id
      ORDER BY f.invoice_date,f.supplier_invoice_id,x.supplier_invoice_item_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) prior_billed
  FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN supplier_invoices f ON f.supplier_invoice_id=x.supplier_invoice_id
  JOIN purchase_order_items p ON p.po_item_id=x.po_item_id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.po_item_id=x.po_item_id
  WHERE f.invoice_date<='2025-12-31'
), allocated AS (
  SELECT supplier_invoice_id,SUM(CASE WHEN accepted<=prior_billed THEN 0
    WHEN accepted-prior_billed>=quantity_billed THEN quantity_billed
    ELSE accepted-prior_billed END*po_price) received FROM lines GROUP BY supplier_invoice_id
)
SELECT b.supplier_invoice_id,b.po_id,b.billed_cents,b.paid_cents,a.received received_cents,
  b.billed_cents-a.received bill_difference_cents,b.paid_cents-a.received paid_difference_cents
FROM v_invoice_balance b JOIN allocated a ON a.supplier_invoice_id=b.supplier_invoice_id
WHERE b.paid_cents>0 AND ABS(b.billed_cents-a.received)>100
ORDER BY ABS(b.billed_cents-a.received) DESC,b.supplier_invoice_id

WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(CASE WHEN balance_cents>0 THEN balance_cents ELSE 0 END) outstanding,SUM(CASE WHEN balance_cents>0 AND due_date<'2025-12-31' THEN balance_cents ELSE 0 END) overdue FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) n,SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) good FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY supplier_id), z AS (SELECT s.supplier_id,COALESCE(a.outstanding,0) outstanding,COALESCE(a.overdue,0) overdue,100.0*a.overdue/NULLIF(a.outstanding,0) overdue_pct,COALESCE(b.n,0) due_lines,100.0*b.good/NULLIF(b.n,0) ontime_pct FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id) SELECT supplier_id,outstanding outstanding_cents,overdue overdue_cents,ROUND(overdue_pct,2) overdue_pct,due_lines,ROUND(ontime_pct,2) ontime_pct FROM z WHERE (overdue>=500000 AND overdue_pct>40) OR (due_lines>=10 AND ontime_pct<60) ORDER BY outstanding DESC,supplier_id

WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(CASE WHEN balance_cents>0 THEN balance_cents ELSE 0 END) outstanding,SUM(CASE WHEN balance_cents>0 AND due_date<'2025-12-31' THEN balance_cents ELSE 0 END) overdue FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) n,SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) good FROM v_po_lines WHERE (promised_date>='2025-01-01' AND promised_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY supplier_id), z AS (SELECT s.supplier_id,COALESCE(a.outstanding,0) outstanding,COALESCE(a.overdue,0) overdue,100.0*a.overdue/NULLIF(a.outstanding,0) overdue_pct,COALESCE(b.n,0) due_lines,100.0*b.good/NULLIF(b.n,0) ontime_pct FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id) SELECT supplier_id,outstanding outstanding_cents,overdue overdue_cents,ROUND(overdue_pct,2) overdue_pct,due_lines,ROUND(ontime_pct,2) ontime_pct FROM z WHERE (overdue>=500000 AND overdue_pct>40) OR (due_lines>=10 AND ontime_pct<60) ORDER BY outstanding DESC,supplier_id

WITH a AS (SELECT s.source_id,SUM(o.net_cents) net,SUM(o.net_cents-o.cost_cents) gross FROM v_order_net o JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=o.session_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.source_id), b AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY source_id) SELECT t.source_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(b.spend,0) spend_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0) contribution_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0))/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) contribution_pct FROM traffic_sources t LEFT JOIN a ON a.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.source_id=t.source_id ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC,t.source_id

WITH a AS (SELECT s.source_id,SUM(o.net_cents) net,SUM(o.net_cents-o.cost_cents) gross FROM v_order_net o JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=o.session_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND (o.order_date>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY s.source_id), b AS (SELECT source_id,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE (month_key>='2025-01' AND month_key<='2025-12') GROUP BY source_id) SELECT t.source_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(b.spend,0) spend_cents,COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0) contribution_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.gross,0)-COALESCE(b.spend,0))/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) contribution_pct FROM traffic_sources t LEFT JOIN a ON a.source_id=t.source_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.source_id=t.source_id ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC,t.source_id

WITH f AS (SELECT o.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn FROM v_order_net o WHERE channel='online'), a AS (SELECT f.customer_id,f.order_date,d.day_index idx,s.source_id,SUBSTR(f.order_date,1,7) m FROM f JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=f.session_id JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=f.order_date WHERE f.rn=1), n AS (SELECT source_id,m,COUNT(*) customers FROM a GROUP BY source_id,m), g AS (SELECT a.source_id,a.m,a.customer_id,SUM(o.net_cents-o.cost_cents) gross FROM a JOIN f o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=o.order_date AND d.day_index BETWEEN a.idx AND a.idx+89 WHERE a.idx+89<=(SELECT day_index FROM calendar_days WHERE day='2025-12-31') GROUP BY a.source_id,a.m,a.customer_id), z AS (SELECT source_id,m,COUNT(*) mature,AVG(gross) avg_gross FROM g GROUP BY source_id,m) SELECT z.source_id,z.m cohort,z.mature,n.customers new_customers,ROUND(z.avg_gross,2) gross90_per_customer_cents,ROUND(1.0*p.spend_cents/n.customers,2) cac_cents,ROUND(z.avg_gross-1.0*p.spend_cents/n.customers,2) difference_cents FROM z JOIN n ON n.source_id=z.source_id AND n.m=z.m LEFT JOIN marketing_campaigns p ON p.source_id=z.source_id AND p.month_key=z.m ORDER BY z.source_id,z.m

WITH f AS (SELECT o.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn FROM v_order_net o WHERE channel='online'), a AS (SELECT f.customer_id,f.order_date,d.day_index idx,s.source_id,SUBSTR(f.order_date,1,7) m FROM f JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=f.session_id JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=f.order_date WHERE f.rn=1), n AS (SELECT source_id,m,SUM(1) customers FROM a GROUP BY source_id,m), g AS (SELECT a.source_id,a.m,a.customer_id,SUM(o.net_cents-o.cost_cents) gross FROM a JOIN f o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=o.order_date AND d.day_index BETWEEN a.idx AND a.idx+89 WHERE a.idx+89<=(SELECT day_index FROM calendar_days WHERE day='2025-12-31') GROUP BY a.source_id,a.m,a.customer_id), z AS (SELECT source_id,m,SUM(1) mature,AVG(gross) avg_gross FROM g GROUP BY source_id,m) SELECT z.source_id,z.m cohort,z.mature,n.customers new_customers,ROUND(z.avg_gross,2) gross90_per_customer_cents,ROUND(1.0*p.spend_cents/n.customers,2) cac_cents,ROUND(z.avg_gross-1.0*p.spend_cents/n.customers,2) difference_cents FROM z JOIN n ON n.source_id=z.source_id AND n.m=z.m LEFT JOIN marketing_campaigns p ON p.source_id=z.source_id AND p.month_key=z.m ORDER BY z.source_id,z.m

WITH a AS (SELECT o.session_id,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents) gross_revenue,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents) original_cost FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.status='completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.session_id), b AS (SELECT session_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY session_id) SELECT s.source_id,SUM(a.gross_revenue) before_refund_cents,SUM(b.refund) refund_cents,ROUND(100.0*SUM(b.refund)/NULLIF(SUM(a.gross_revenue),0),2) refund_pct,SUM(a.gross_revenue-a.original_cost) before_gross_cents,SUM(b.net-b.cost) after_gross_cents FROM customer_sessions s JOIN a ON a.session_id=s.session_id JOIN b ON b.session_id=s.session_id GROUP BY s.source_id ORDER BY refund_pct DESC,s.source_id

WITH a AS (SELECT o.session_id,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents) gross_revenue,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents) original_cost FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.status='completed' AND (o.order_date>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY o.session_id), b AS (SELECT session_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='online' AND (order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY session_id) SELECT s.source_id,SUM(a.gross_revenue) before_refund_cents,SUM(b.refund) refund_cents,ROUND(100.0*SUM(b.refund)/NULLIF(SUM(a.gross_revenue),0),2) refund_pct,SUM(a.gross_revenue-a.original_cost) before_gross_cents,SUM(b.net-b.cost) after_gross_cents FROM customer_sessions s JOIN a ON a.session_id=s.session_id JOIN b ON b.session_id=s.session_id GROUP BY s.source_id ORDER BY refund_pct DESC,s.source_id

WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(labor_cents) labor,SUM(worked_minutes+overtime_minutes) minutes_worked FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(b.labor,0) labor_cents,ROUND(1.0*COALESCE(b.minutes_worked,0)/60,2) worked_hours,ROUND(60.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.minutes_worked,0),2) sales_per_hour_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(b.labor,0)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) labor_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id

WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND (order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<='2025-12-31') GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(labor_cents) labor,SUM(worked_minutes+overtime_minutes) minutes_worked FROM v_staff_month WHERE (month_key>='2025-01' AND month_key<='2025-12') AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(b.labor,0) labor_cents,ROUND(1.0*COALESCE(b.minutes_worked,0)/60,2) worked_hours,ROUND(60.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.minutes_worked,0),2) sales_per_hour_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(b.labor,0)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) labor_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id

WITH m AS (SELECT month_key,MAX(day) last_day FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2024-12' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key), h AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COUNT(e.employee_id) headcount FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN employment_history e ON e.store_id=s.store_id AND e.start_date<=m.last_day AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date>m.last_day) GROUP BY s.store_id,m.month_key), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date>='2024-12-01' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), z AS (SELECT h.*,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM h LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=h.store_id AND a.m=h.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(headcount) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev_h,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev_net FROM z) SELECT store_id,month_key,headcount,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(headcount-prev_h)/NULLIF(prev_h,0),2) headcount_change_pct,ROUND(100.0*(net-prev_net)/NULLIF(prev_net,0),2) sales_change_pct,CASE WHEN headcount>prev_h AND net<prev_net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END review_flag FROM p WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY store_id,month_key

WITH m AS (SELECT month_key,MAX(day) last_day FROM calendar_days WHERE (month_key>='2024-12' AND month_key<='2025-12') GROUP BY month_key), h AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COUNT(e.employee_id) headcount FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN employment_history e ON e.store_id=s.store_id AND e.start_date<=m.last_day AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date>m.last_day) GROUP BY s.store_id,m.month_key), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date>='2024-12-01' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), z AS (SELECT h.*,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM h LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=h.store_id AND a.m=h.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(headcount) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev_h,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev_net FROM z) SELECT store_id,month_key,headcount,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(headcount-prev_h)/NULLIF(prev_h,0),2) headcount_change_pct,ROUND(100.0*(net-prev_net)/NULLIF(prev_net,0),2) sales_change_pct,CASE WHEN headcount>prev_h AND net<prev_net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END review_flag FROM p WHERE (month_key>='2025-01' AND month_key<='2025-12') ORDER BY store_id,month_key

WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12'), s AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(net_cents-cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), f AS (SELECT SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7) m,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7)), h AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(labor_cents) labor FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key), p AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(ordered_cents) procurement FROM v_po_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), a AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key) SELECT m.month_key,COALESCE(s.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(f.expense,0) expense_cents,COALESCE(h.labor,0) labor_cents,COALESCE(a.spend,0) advertising_cents,COALESCE(p.procurement,0) committed_purchase_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0)-COALESCE(f.expense,0)-COALESCE(h.labor,0) operating_contribution_cents FROM m LEFT JOIN s ON s.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN f ON f.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN h ON h.month_key=m.month_key LEFT JOIN p ON p.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN a ON a.month_key=m.month_key ORDER BY m.month_key

WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE (month_key>='2025-01' AND month_key<='2025-12')), s AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(net_cents-cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), f AS (SELECT SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7) m,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(entry_date,1,7)), h AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(labor_cents) labor FROM v_staff_month WHERE (month_key>='2025-01' AND month_key<='2025-12') GROUP BY month_key), p AS (SELECT SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(ordered_cents) procurement FROM v_po_lines WHERE order_date>='2025-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), a AS (SELECT month_key,SUM(spend_cents) spend FROM marketing_campaigns WHERE (month_key>='2025-01' AND month_key<='2025-12') GROUP BY month_key) SELECT m.month_key,COALESCE(s.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0) gross_cents,COALESCE(f.expense,0) expense_cents,COALESCE(h.labor,0) labor_cents,COALESCE(a.spend,0) advertising_cents,COALESCE(p.procurement,0) committed_purchase_cents,COALESCE(s.gross,0)-COALESCE(f.expense,0)-COALESCE(h.labor,0) operating_contribution_cents FROM m LEFT JOIN s ON s.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN f ON f.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN h ON h.month_key=m.month_key LEFT JOIN p ON p.m=m.month_key LEFT JOIN a ON a.month_key=m.month_key ORDER BY m.month_key

WITH qm AS (
  SELECT month_key,CONCAT(SUBSTR(month_key,1,4),'-Q',
    CASE WHEN SUBSTR(month_key,6,2)<='03' THEN '1' WHEN SUBSTR(month_key,6,2)<='06' THEN '2'
      WHEN SUBSTR(month_key,6,2)<='09' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END) q,MAX(day) month_end
  FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key
), qs AS (
  SELECT q,MAX(month_end) end_day FROM qm GROUP BY q
), s AS (
  SELECT qm.q,SUM(v.net_cents) net,SUM(v.net_cents-v.cost_cents) gross
  FROM v_sales_lines v JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=SUBSTR(v.order_date,1,7) GROUP BY qm.q
), f AS (
  SELECT qm.q,SUM(v.expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses v
  JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=SUBSTR(v.entry_date,1,7) GROUP BY qm.q
), h AS (
  SELECT qm.q,SUM(v.labor_cents) labor FROM v_staff_month v
  JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=v.month_key GROUP BY qm.q
), p AS (
  SELECT qm.q,COUNT(*) n,SUM(CASE WHEN v.on_time>=v.quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) good
  FROM v_po_lines v JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=SUBSTR(v.promised_date,1,7) GROUP BY qm.q
), i AS (
  SELECT qs.q,CASE WHEN COUNT(x.snapshot_id)=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products)*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses)
    THEN SUM(x.quantity*x.unit_cost_cents) ELSE NULL END stock
  FROM qs LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots x ON x.snapshot_date=qs.end_day GROUP BY qs.q
), metrics AS (
  SELECT qs.q,s.net,100.0*s.gross/NULLIF(s.net,0) margin,
    100.0*COALESCE(f.expense,0)/NULLIF(s.net,0) expense_pct,
    100.0*COALESCE(h.labor,0)/NULLIF(s.net,0) labor_pct,
    100.0*p.good/NULLIF(p.n,0) delivery,i.stock FROM qs
  LEFT JOIN s ON s.q=qs.q LEFT JOIN f ON f.q=qs.q LEFT JOIN h ON h.q=qs.q
  LEFT JOIN p ON p.q=qs.q LEFT JOIN i ON i.q=qs.q
), compared AS (
  SELECT a.*,a.margin-b.margin margin_change,a.expense_pct-b.expense_pct expense_change,
    a.labor_pct-b.labor_pct labor_change FROM metrics a
  LEFT JOIN metrics b ON b.q=CONCAT('2024',SUBSTR(a.q,5)) WHERE a.q BETWEEN '2025-Q1' AND '2025-Q4'
)
SELECT q,net net_cents,ROUND(margin,2) margin_pct,ROUND(expense_pct,2) expense_pct,
  ROUND(labor_pct,2) labor_pct,ROUND(delivery,2) delivery_pct,stock stock_cents,
  ROUND(margin_change,2) margin_change_points,ROUND(expense_change,2) expense_change_points,
  ROUND(labor_change,2) labor_change_points,
  CASE WHEN margin_change < -3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN expense_change>10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    +CASE WHEN labor_change>10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN delivery<60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END risk_count,
  CASE WHEN margin_change IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN expense_change IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    +CASE WHEN labor_change IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN delivery IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    +CASE WHEN stock IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END missing_count
FROM compared ORDER BY q
